limite: Example data for preparing a review. This result does not award a grade or grant eligibility to take part.
carga: Loading the exercise cases. Please wait.
error: The exercise could not be loaded. Select Retry. If the problem continues, contact IT.

ayuda.elegir: Filter by route and select an example person.
ayuda.revisar: Review the available data and pending reasons. Position level and personal grade are separate data.
ayuda.descargar: Download the draft and check the details against your documents. Downloading it does not submit an application.

lista.sin_filtro: There are no cases for this route. Select All routes to view the full exercise.
lista.vacia: The exercise contains no cases. Ask IT to check the preparation.

detalle.separacion: The level describes the position. Personal grade requires recognition; it is not derived from the position level.
detalle.motivo_pendiente: The reason has not been confirmed. Contact the Career team.
detalle.sin_comprobaciones: There are no prepared checks for this case.
detalle.responsable: HR must review the information and applicable rules before processing recognition or an application.
detalle.dependencia_pendiente: Confirm the procedure and responsible team.
detalle.bloqueo: The approved procedure, competent decision and entry in Personnel are pending. This screen only prepares the review.
detalle.elegir: Select a case to review its data.

exportar.limite: The download includes the reviewed cases. It is a draft; use the appropriate procedure to submit an application.
exportar.preparado: The draft download has been prepared. Check your downloads folder.

motivo.disponible: The information is available for this review. Compare it with the relevant document before continuing.
motivo.datos_incompletos: Person data is missing for the review.
motivo.fuente_incompleta: Information is missing to complete the review.
motivo.regimen_incompatible: The employment regime does not match this route. Check the information before continuing.
motivo.periodos_incompletos: Service periods or their dates are missing.
motivo.fecha_invalida: A date is invalid. Correct it and review again.
motivo.periodos_solapados: Some periods overlap. Review them before calculating service.
motivo.evidencia_incompleta: Evidence or its accreditation is missing.
motivo.politica_pendiente: An approved policy has not been confirmed for this procedure.
motivo.politica_preparada: An example policy is prepared. Its approval remains pending.
motivo.curso_prueba_pendiente: The course and test required by the procedure need confirmation.
motivo.resolucion_necesaria: Recognition requires a decision by the competent unit.
motivo.registro_necesario: Personnel must register the effective act. The exercise does not make that entry.

pendiente.fuentes: Check the information and documents used.
pendiente.compatibilidad: Confirm the regime and route with the competent unit.
pendiente.evidencias: Provide and accredit the required evidence.
pendiente.curso_prueba: Confirm and accredit the course and test.
pendiente.registro: Register the effective act in Personnel.
